{{Quote|You there, droid!"<br />"Yes"<br />"What is your primary function?"<br />"I'm a G-12 service droid, My Lord. My primary function is maintenance.|Satal Keto and a G-12|<ref name="audio" />}}
'''G-12''' was a model of [[service droid/Legends|service droids]] used by [[Krath/Legends|the Krath]] in the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]], also used by them [[Interrogation droid/Legends|for torture]]. They were equipped with a [[Holorecorder/Legends|Holorecorder]].<ref name="audio" />

It was such a droid where [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] recorded a secret message to captive [[Nomi Sunrider]], which however was intercepted by [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] and [[Norgor]], confirming his suspicions that the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]] was not really a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|rogue]], but a [[spy/Legends|spy]].<ref name="audio">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref><ref name="Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref>
{{Stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The G-12 first appears in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|fifth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'']] comic series. Its model designation was first heard in the [[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]].<ref name="audio" />
